stages.journal: Hedda's survey mule bolted on the quarry road and her cipher pages went into the burn with the wreck. The Hewers clear wrecks the way they clear everything: into the spoil, squared and stacked. The pages are measurements, she says. Only measurements. She says it twice, which is once too many. Break the *waking quarry's* shift and bring the pages back.

The pages are not only measurements. Between the distances, in the same neat cipher, are questions about the sealing, the kind a king asks when he cannot ask. Ruen runs this town, and the town was built on not asking. Tell the *Delfmaster* what you are carrying before you decide whose hands it ends in.
